TBS_Indigenous_subgroups_by_department_2.sourceNote: SOURCE: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat. Distribution of public service of Canada employees by sub-group and department or agency - Indigenous Peoples (as of March 31 2025). Page modified 2026-06-24. https://www.canada.ca/en/treasury-board-secretariat/services/innovation/human-resources-statistics/diversity-inclusion-statistics/distribution-public-service-canada-employees-designated-sub-group-department-indigenous-peoples.html. WFA for Indigenous Peoples: 4.0%. "suppressed" = counts of 1 to 5 and other values suppressed by TBS to avoid residual disclosure. Department notes in parentheses are from TBS footnotes. Transcribed verbatim; thousands separators removed.

TBS_disability_subgroups_by_department_2.sourceNote: SOURCE: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat. Distribution of public service of Canada employees by sub-group and department or agency - Persons with disabilities (as of March 31 2024). Page modified 2026-06-24. https://www.canada.ca/en/treasury-board-secretariat/services/innovation/human-resources-statistics/diversity-inclusion-statistics/distribution-public-service-canada-employees-designated-sub-group-department-persons-disabilities.html. WFA for persons with disabilities: 12.0%. Subgroup counts do not sum to the group total because one person can report more than one disability (TBS footnote). "suppressed" = counts of 1 to 5 and other cells suppressed by TBS. Canadian Transportation Agency deaf/hard of hearing % cell shows an unlinked asterisk on the TBS page and is recorded as suppressed. 2025 table not transcribed: department labels on the 2025 page appear misaligned with the rows (see source inventory). Transcribed verbatim; thousands separators removed.

sourceAnomalies.reason: The transcribed source count exceeds both the group total and the organization total. A blank marks an unavailable value. No corrected count has been inferred.

DI_di_disproportionality_index_2017-2025.population: Independent Disproportionality Index project, using TBS salary-band data and project imputation estimates. Not an official TBS product.
corrections: 2021 shares and ratios recalculated from the existing project counts.
2024 and 2025 bottom bands are less than $70,000; 2025 next band starts at $70,000.
DI_di_disproportionality_index_2017-2025.limits: No new counts or imputation estimates were created. The source project includes estimates; these do not replace suppressed official values.
DI_di_disproportionality_index_2017-2025.retainedSourceDiscrepancy: The 2022 visible-minority band shares total 99.83%, as in the received file. No missing share or count is inferred.
